d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we explore the major revelations from Joe Biden’s latest memoir, Promise Me, America. From his candid accounts of Donald Trump and the January 6 Capitol riots to his tense conversations with Benjamin Netanyahu, Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping and Volodymyr Zelensky, Biden offers a behind-the-scenes look at his presidency, the wars in Afghanistan, Ukraine and Gaza, and his relationships with some of the world’s most powerful leaders.
